stars.1: Prototype/idea exists; not reliable production workflow.
stars.2: Basic end-to-end function works with important limitations.
stars.3: Production-usable for ordinary workflows; measurable reliability.
stars.4: Competitive with established category leaders in capability and UX.
stars.5: Meets or exceeds best-in-class reference on agreed tests, reliability and user validation; no critical gap.

rule: A category may not be manually set to 5. Evidence IDs and passing acceptance tests are required.
